newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-BENFICA SET TO SIGN AMARAL AND HELDER ON LOAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BENFICA SET TO SIGN AMARAL AND HELDER ON LOAN.

text.p: Benfica of Portugal say they hope to sign Brazilian midfielder Amaral and Dutch international winger Glenn Helder on loan after losing two first team defenders this month.

Club director Francisco Colaco said Helder, currently playing for Arsenal in England, would arrive in Lisbon on Friday for medical tests and could stay with the first division side until the end of the season.
Amaral is due to arrive for tests next week. He plays for Parma in Italy but they have agreed to loan him for the rest of the season with the option of a permanent transfer later.
Neither of the new recruits would be able to play for Benfica in the Cup Winners' Cup as both have played for their current sides in Europe this season.

Helder and Amaral would replace Portuguese international Helder Cristovao, who said on Wednesday he hoped to sign for Spain's Deportivo de Coruna soon, and Dimas Teixeira, who moved to European champions Juventus earlier this month.
Benfica are second in the Portuguese league, three points behind defending champions Porto.
